AtruhaTeX Pi 3.1 maintenance update.

• Choose Download and install, Download and install on exit, or Discard.
• Install from Settings without closing it first. Unsaved projects get a save prompt; immediate installation reopens AtruhaTeX automatically.
• Texlab is detected correctly, and an offline Python/SymPy solver is included in the installer.
• Accurate cursor placement on mixed Arabic and LaTeX lines.
• Compact expandable issue cards and improved Review Fix previews, package suggestions, and common command corrections.

The application version remains 1.0.1. These updater controls take effect after this update is installed.
